scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('node', ['server/src/server.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
